baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb at word 2 governs the feminine object pronoun, while words 3-4 name a distinct recipient collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: A holding passes out of prior possession and is made the inheritance of a socially distinct successor group.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary passage from former holder to heir supplies the transfer mechanism enacted by the causative verb.
The people-group image makes the recipient a collective body rather than an individual heir.
The later-or-other image marks a successor distinct from the former holders.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified group merely receives an unspecified thing.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a complete succession event: prior possession is converted into the inheritance of another collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first-person causative at word 2 and the replacement-capable root of qawm at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The transfer is not a bargain between old and new holders; an external agent installs a substitute people into what preceded them.

activation_trace.role: The causative allotment without bargain or toil turns inheritance into an imposed bestowal rather than a negotiated purchase.
Standing in another's place gives the recipient people the functional role of substitute occupants.
Otherness keeps the substitute body discontinuous from the displaced one.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance is passive acquisition by ordinary heirs.
changed_reading.after: Another people is actively installed into a vacated social and material position without title flowing from the former holders.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The bestowed inheritance at word 2 is received by qawm at word 3, whose root can activate maintenance and guardianship.
baseline_models.mechanism: Receiving the holding can be heard as receiving responsibility for what keeps a collective standing, so succession carries stewardship as well as benefit.

activation_trace.role: The bestowed allotment supplies the entrusted holding.
Care, guardianship, and preservation recast the recipient collective as maintainers of the allotment.
A new holder permits stewardship to pass while the holding persists.

changed_reading.before: The new people simply owns what the old people lost.
changed_reading.after: The new people receives a maintenance office along with the inherited benefit, making ownership conditional in function.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Inheritance at word 2, a people at word 3, and the laterness potential of the adjective at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse orders collectives in time: one station outlasts its occupants and is handed forward to a later people.

activation_trace.role: Passage from predecessors to heirs creates the temporal relay.
Station and residence make the inherited object a place in which successive groups can stand.
Deferral to a later time makes 'other' carry chronological succession as well as identity difference.

changed_reading.before: Another people is merely a different population.
changed_reading.after: Another people is also the later bearer in a relay whose station survives each temporary occupant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inheritance verb at word 2 has a branch for knowledge, scripture, and virtue, while words 3-4 preserve a collective recipient.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside material succession, the construction can carry a second register in which a people receives transmissible knowledge, memory, or moral capacity from predecessors.

activation_trace.role: Inheritance of knowledge, scripture, or virtue opens a nonmaterial channel inside the same verb.
The collective image allows a shared tradition rather than a private possession to be transmitted.
A distinct later group supplies the receiving generation for a transmissible legacy.

changed_reading.before: Only tangible property passes to the successors.
changed_reading.after: Material succession may simultaneously transmit a lesson, record, or capacity that survives its first holders.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies binding inscription, differentiation, governing matter, and firm ordering; together they make the later inheritance look like an apportioned installation rather than incidental spoil.

activation_trace.role: The causative allotment gives the opening decree-field a concrete transfer to govern.
Substitution supplies the office into which the decreed recipient is placed.
A binding inscription that establishes judgment or destiny supplies the juridical frame for the transfer.
Distinguishing one thing from another gives the allotment its separating and assigning operation.
Authority and office turn the differentiated matter into a governed succession.
Firm construction and exact ordering resist a reading of the transfer as accidental.

structural_cues: The opening moves from a written object to differentiated matters and then repeatedly uses first-person sending and causation before the first-person inheritance verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding establishment, distinction, authority, and firm ordering; I supply the arrow that these operations govern the transfer in 44:28. A live alternative is that the opening decree-field and the historical succession remain parallel rather than causally linked.

changed_reading.before: The transfer follows collapse as an opportunistic aftermath.
changed_reading.after: The transfer is an intentionally differentiated allotment that installs a successor collective under a prior ordering.

context_deltas.mechanism: A demand to discharge a right concerning controlled servants is followed by domination, removal, pursuit, death, and an estate left behind; inheritance then reads as reversal of title and office, not mere seizure.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary passage of an estate supplies the legal result after former control ends.
Standing in another's place converts regime removal into collective replacement.
Discharging a right or trust frames the requested handover as an obligation rather than a favor.
The slavery-and-ownership image exposes the prior regime's treatment of persons as controlled property.
Domination and seizure identify the vertical power relation that the inheritance reverses.
Removal of a governor from office supplies a precise institutional image for dispossession.
What a dead person leaves behind turns the abandoned holdings into an estate ready for succession.
Death by drowning terminates the former holders' practical control and enables the estate transition.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from a demanded handover of persons, through separation and pursuit, to the old regime's abandoned holdings immediately before 44:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation, servitude, domination, office-removal, death, and an estate-left-behind image; I infer a de facto transfer of title across that sequence. The live alternative is a simpler spoil-after-defeat account with no juridical force.

changed_reading.before: The victors acquire the defeated regime's goods.
changed_reading.after: The old regime loses both its control over persons and its office over resources, while another collective is granted the vacated title.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gardens, flowing sources, cultivation, residence, honor, ease, and delighted consumption form one life-support system; the feminine object in the focus can gather that whole system into the inherited 'it.'

activation_trace.role: The estate-transfer image receives the preceding resource list as a coherent holding.
Mainstay and subsistence turn the recipient people into dependents on an inherited support system.
A residual trace left after departure keeps the infrastructure present when its users disappear.
Tree-covered gardens supply productive enclosed land to the estate.
Flowing water sources supply the estate's renewable water layer.
Sowing and crop growth make the holding an ongoing production system rather than static treasure.
Residence and station add settled social placement to the material resources.
Honor and esteemed generosity show that status is embedded in the inherited station.
Softness and ease of life supply the estate's experiential benefit.
Pleasant delight shows the social use produced by the gardens, water, crops, and station.

structural_cues: The feminine singular object pronoun follows a coordinated inventory spread across 44:25-27, allowing a distributed estate to be resumed as one bundle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the list and each material or social image; I infer that their co-listing forms the antecedent bundle of the pronoun. A narrower antecedent remains grammatically possible.

changed_reading.before: The successors receive generic wealth or territory.
changed_reading.after: They receive an integrated ecology and political economy: water, cultivation, dwelling, status, and the mode of life those supports produce.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus gardens, springs, and honored station recur after the focus as a safe station, gardens, and springs; the focus becomes the hinge between two differently qualified modes of inhabiting a similar abundance.

activation_trace.role: Inheritance supplies the hinge that can relate an abandoned dwelling-complex to a later secure one.
Substitution lets the two station scenes model changed occupancy rather than mere repeated scenery.
The first tree-covered garden image establishes one side of the mirror.
The first flowing-source image completes the resource pair before the focus.
The first station is a settled residence qualified by honor.
Honor supplies the unstable old station's positive social valuation.
The later station repeats residence while moving it into a new security condition.
Settled safety distinguishes the later station from the merely honored station that was lost.
The second garden image restores the earlier land form on the far side of the focus.
The second flowing-source image closes the lexical mirror.

structural_cues: The sequence gardens-springs-station before 44:28 returns as station-gardens-springs after it, with the station's qualifier changing from honor to safety.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated lexical architecture; I infer that 44:28 functions as its transfer hinge. The alternative is formal echo without identity of estate, recipients, or historical location, so the model does not require those identities.

changed_reading.before: The verse closes one episode of abandoned luxury.
changed_reading.after: The verse mediates between two residence systems and asks what changes when abundance passes from honored but insecure occupancy to protected occupancy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate denial of mourning and reprieve removes both affective recognition and temporal extension from the former holders, sharpening succession into an abrupt cancellation.

activation_trace.role: The passing estate marks what continues when its former holders receive no continuation.
A substitute people occupies the opening produced by the former group's erased tenure.
Laterness makes the new people's time begin where the old people's extension is refused.
Grief expressed in tears and sound is explicitly absent, stripping the departure of communal lament.
Waiting and granted delay are explicitly absent, closing the former holders' time without extension.

structural_cues: The inheritance statement is followed immediately by two coordinated negations concerning cosmic response and delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent grief and absent reprieve; I infer that these negate recognized continuity of the old tenure. They may instead function only as narrative closure, leaving the transfer emotionally neutral.

changed_reading.before: Succession is a neutral handoff between populations.
changed_reading.after: Succession is an unsentimental cancellation: the estate continues, but the former holders receive neither recognition nor extra time.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, a collective is extracted from degrading control, named through descent, selected with knowledge, and given manifest tests; this activates the possibility that a successor people is constituted through rescue and trial rather than merely found waiting.

activation_trace.role: Causative bestowal supplies the installation through which a rescued collective can become a successor.
The people-group image is the social body potentially formed by the subsequent operations.
Otherness leaves room for a newly configured collective rather than a continuation of the oppressive one.
Deliverance by separation supplies the extraction that can constitute a new social body.
Descent and attribution to an origin supply genealogical cohesion to the rescued group.
Selection for soundness adds purposive formation rather than accidental survival.
Testing that reveals condition makes succession a proving process as well as a reward.

structural_cues: The post-focus movement is rescue, naming, selection, and testing, a sequence of operations performed upon a collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies those constitutive operations; I infer that they illuminate what it can mean to make 'another people' inherit. The alternative is that the post-focus collective is only a parallel example and should not be identified with the focus recipients.

changed_reading.before: A ready-made population replaces another population.
changed_reading.after: A successor people may be produced through extraction, renewed affiliation, selection, and testing before or as it receives a station.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ordinary inheritance can travel through kinship or another cause, but the focus names the recipients as an other people and supplies divine causation; the later collapse of patronal bonds exposes this title as non-genealogical.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary inheritance image permits title by kinship or cause, making the source of title a live question.
A whole people rather than a family receives the holding.
Otherness interrupts any automatic assumption of descent from the former holders.
Kinship, emancipation, and neighborly patronage name the bonds that the later negation renders unable to secure anyone.

structural_cues: The causative subject grants inheritance to 'another people,' while the later paired patron nouns are placed under a total negation of mutual efficacy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inheritance branch allowing kinship-or-cause and a later negated patronal bond; I infer that divine causation replaces genealogy as title. The later judgment scene may not directly regulate the earlier historical transfer.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance loosely likens national succession to family succession.
changed_reading.after: The verse constructs a non-genealogical title: an unrelated collective inherits because it is made heir, not because it descends from the former owners.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of being raised is answered by an appointed separation and universal gathering, activating qawm as those made to stand and making every historical installation provisional.

activation_trace.role: Successive inheritance shows that present possession already depends on prior displacement.
Resurrection and standing before the final event turn the recipient people into future standers, not terminal owners.
Laterness opens the historical transfer toward a still later reckoning.
Reviving the dead after death supplies the future rising denied by the speakers.
A judgment separating truth from falsehood limits the value of inherited worldly position.
A fixed time or limit places an outer boundary around every people's tenure.
Gathering dispersed parts into one reverses the serial separation of successive peoples.

structural_cues: Historical groups replace one another in the focus, whereas the later appointed day gathers all of them into one simultaneous scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resurrection, separation, timing, and gathering; I connect qawm's resurrection branch to those later cues and infer bounded tenure. The ordinary collective sense of qawm remains the stronger grammatical reading.

changed_reading.before: The successor people is the endpoint of the transfer.
changed_reading.after: The successor's standing is interim: historical heirs become later standers at a gathering that cancels serial possession as final status.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact discourse reset reappears before another first-person causative act, activating an analogy between assigning an estate to a people and joining people into new relational pairs.

activation_trace.role: Causative bestowal supplies one externally enacted reassignment.
Standing in another's place makes inheritance a changed relation between people and station.
Making one thing the companion of another supplies the parallel operation of relational placement.

structural_cues: Both 44:28 and 44:54 begin with the same 'thus/like that' reset and continue with a first-person plural causative verb carrying an attached object pronoun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula and two causative relation-changing verbs; I infer a formal analogy between territorial succession and pairing. The repetition may instead be only a discourse marker with no shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance concerns a commodity that changes hands.
changed_reading.after: Inheritance is one instance of a broader relational rearrangement in which agents, places, and companions are newly joined.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with a written message being delivered and closes with language made accessible for recollection; this activates the focus inheritance branch for a legacy that travels through communicative carriers as well as possessions.

activation_trace.role: Inherited knowledge, scripture, or virtue supplies the nonmaterial object-channel.
A people-group can carry shared memory beyond the life of its first hearers.
Ordered letters and the written object supply a durable transmissible record.
Causing something to arrive supplies the first delivery of the record into human reception.
Messenger and message supply the human relay through which the legacy moves.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the legacy's intended persistence in later minds.
Conveying a message through language supplies the accessible vehicle of transmission.

structural_cues: Written disclosure frames the beginning, while accessible language and recollection frame the ending around the historical transfer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a record-delivery-recollection circuit and the focus supplies nonmaterial inheritance; I infer a secondary legacy register. I do not reassign the feminine pronoun to the distant book, and the immediate material antecedent remains live.

changed_reading.before: Only the abandoned estate crosses from one people to another.
changed_reading.after: The succession also carries a communicable record of what happened, making later people potential heirs to warning and memory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier naming of first ancestors activates both beginning and one-after-another succession against the focus adjective, so 'other' becomes a temporal office in a chain rather than only an ethnic label.

activation_trace.role: Inheritance makes the relation between first and later holders transmissive rather than merely contrastive.
Replacement gives each people a serial position previously occupied by another.
Later-or-other explicitly supplies the second pole of the temporal chain.
Beginning and precedence supply the first pole against which the later people is heard.
The non-dominant mapping's one-after-another sequence turns first/later contrast into serial succession.

structural_cues: The context names first ancestors before the focus and repeatedly returns to firstness later, while the focus marks its recipients as other or later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies firstness, a split mapping for serial following, and focus laterness; I infer a succession chain. The adjective can remain purely contrastive, and the non-dominant mapping should not replace its ordinary sense.

changed_reading.before: The adjective classifies the recipients as a different people.
changed_reading.after: It also assigns them a later slot in an open chain, implying that today's heirs can become tomorrow's predecessors.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the fire-stirring branch of the inheritance root rather than its ordinary estate sense. It remains anchored in the exact focus verb and is independently awakened by the later blazing-fire field; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory resonance about succession re-igniting residual power, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb at word 2 directly carries an ember-stirring branch, and qawm at word 3 can activate rising to undertake a matter.

activation_trace.role: Stirring embers until fire catches turns transfer into reactivation of what remained latent after collapse.
Rising with resolve lets another people become the body in which the latent remainder catches.
Blazing and severe heat provide a later fire field that activates the focus root's remote ember image.
Blackness, coal, and smoke supply material residue from which renewed burning can be imagined.

changed_reading.before: A dead regime leaves inert assets to its successor.
changed_reading.after: The transfer may also stir the old order's still-live embers inside another people, making succession a possible recurrence of power rather than a clean reset.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant growth mapping for the context root and activates qawm's caretaker branch. It remains valid as a packet-authorized split-root cue anchored in the focus's bestowed inheritance and recipient people; downstream prose should label the people-as-cultivated-successor mechanism branch-induced and keep sovereignty or ordinary lordship as the stronger alternative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes another qawm receive an allotment, allowing the context's nourishment image to modify how that recipient is formed.

activation_trace.role: The bestowed allotment supplies the environment or charge through which the successor can be formed.
Care and preservation make the recipient both a cultivated body and a future caretaker.
The non-dominant nourishment-and-growth image activates formation of the successor rather than mere transfer to it.
Repair, education, and completion give the growth cue a governing developmental counterpart.

changed_reading.before: A pre-existing people receives a finished estate.
changed_reading.after: Receiving the estate may be part of how another people is nourished into standing and trained to preserve what it receives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links scattered legal branches: a written freedom contract, servile ownership, discharge of a right, and patronage by emancipation. It remains anchored in the focus's causative inheritance to another people and in the context's explicit servants-and-handover scene; downstream prose should render it as a legal-social reversal pattern, not claim that the opening book lexically means a manumission contract here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus reverses the property relation by making a people the recipient of an allotment rather than an object under prior control.

activation_trace.role: Being granted an allotment without bargain moves the successor collective into the position of title-holder.
Standing in another's place completes the reversal from controlled group to installed holder.
A slave's written contract toward freedom supplies the remote juridical image of status release.
Performance of a due right makes release an owed discharge rather than discretionary generosity.
Servitude and ownership supply the status from which the collective reversal begins.
Patronage formed by emancipation or kinship supplies the legal bond whose power is later relativized.

changed_reading.before: One population receives another population's property after defeat.
changed_reading.after: The sequence can be heard as a status inversion: persons treated as property are released through a discharged right and become a people capable of holding inherited property.

strongest_changes: The inherited object expands from generic wealth into an integrated ecology of gardens, water, cultivation, station, status, and ease.
The transfer becomes a governed reversal of title and office after the old regime's control over persons and resources is terminated.
The gardens-springs-station pattern returns after the focus with safety replacing mere honor, making 44:28 a hinge between two occupancy regimes.
Another people can mean a later, non-genealogical, and provisionally installed collective rather than only a different ethnic group.
A coexisting nonmaterial register lets historical succession transmit warning and memory without displacing the immediate material antecedent.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is unusually compact but branch-dense: causative inheritance, qawm's standing and substitution field, and the laterness of 'other' let one line function simultaneously as estate transfer, regime replacement, stewardship commission, temporal relay, and memory transmission. The repeated station imagery and the second 'thus' causative scene create strong latent structure, while remote fire, growth, and manumission branches remain inspectable rather than being normalized away.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine object pronoun may gather the entire preceding estate or point to a narrower implicit holding.
The later safe station may echo rather than continue the pre-focus estate, so no identity of place or recipient is required.
Post-focus rescue and selection illuminate how a successor people can be constituted but do not by themselves identify that collective with the focus recipients.
The resurrection, repeated-causative, fire, growth, and manumission readings depend on branch activation beyond the strongest grammatical senses and must remain qualified.
